name: Cannalicious RSO Dart | Rest
description: Named after a Canadian medical marijuana activist, Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a cannabinoid-rich, broad-spectrum extract that contains all the beneficial plant matter and is the most holistic cannabis concentrate available. Rest RSO has a delightful berry flavor and is full of THC, CBD, CBN and a heavy indica terpene profile designed to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. It should only be ingested and never vaped/smoked and has an activation time of 15-60 minutes.
